examples.text: Он вдруг почувствовал себя в положении мышонка, попавшегося в мышеловку на кусочек свиного сальца.

examples.text: До Бероевой дошли слухи, что дело её скоро уже решится, и точно: незадолго после этого её отправили в обычном тюремном ящике, который на тюремном argot весьма характерно именуется «мышеловкой», выслушать решение.

glosses: комп. жарг. активное место на экране, выполняющее что-либо при нажатии на него «мышью» или пером
A device for capturing or killing mice and other rodents.
A website designed to open another copy of itself when the user tries to close the webpage. Frequently used by advertisers and pornographers.

An antisubmarine rocket used mainly during World War II by the US Navy and US Coast Guard.

examples.text: Besides depth charges, they were armed with smaller forward firing antisubmarine rocket launchers called mousetraps. Fired in groups, these rockets detonated when they contacted a submarine.

glosses: To trap; to trick or fool (someone) into a bad situation.

examples.text: He hoped to bring the rebels out of their trenches for a showdown battle somewhere south of the Wilderness, that gloomy expanse of scrub oaks and pines where Lee had mousetrapped Joe Hooker exactly a year earlier.

glosses: To prevent (the user) from leaving a website by opening another copy when it is closed.

examples.text: The scammer is paid for each new visitor directed to his site. There is nothing wrong except that the user finds it impossible to leave the site because he is mousetrapped.
